records.description: Beautifully crafted itineraries for 27 countries. Remix the pace, swap activities, and travel with everything offline.

records.name: Shopify AI Visibility Analysis
records.tagline: See how visible your Shopify store is to AI Chatbots
records.description: AI shopping is here. ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google's AI Mode are recommending products directly to buyers, and most Shopify stores are invisible to them. We built this tool to change that. Paste your store URL and get an instant AI visibility analysis: schema coverage, structured data gaps, and exactly what's stopping AI agents from finding and recommending your products. Built by Kirkby & White, a Shopify development agency that's worked on 100+ stores across 7-9 figure merchants.

records.name: flashcards from ai generated markdown
records.tagline: flashcards
records.description: Markdown flashcard app with SM-2 spaced repetition — desktop Python/tkinter - johnfire/flashmd-python, this app takes docs created with AI and turns them into flashcards for learning

records.name: Puppet Generator
records.tagline: Create Your Puppet Character
records.description: Transform your photos into unique puppet-style characters. Upload a photo and let our AI create your custom puppet character.

records.name: NanoAI
records.tagline: NanoAI: All-in-One AI Creative Studio
records.description: NanoAI is your all-in-one AI creative studio — generate videos, images, cartoons, posters, and more from a single platform. 🎬 AI Video: Powered by Sora, Veo, Kling — text or image to video 🎨 AI Images: 10+ styles, up to 4K, generated in seconds 🖼️ AI Posters & Cartoons: Professional-quality, one click 💸 Pay-as-you-go credits — no subscription required 🛠️ 8+ free tools: QR codes, image resizer, compressor & more

records.name: MarkeTingTong
records.tagline: All in one AI Marketing Research Tool
records.description: All-in-one AI marketing research platform: GEO visibility tracking, competitor funnel analysis, email spam checker, campaign generator & visual funnel builder. Start free.

records.name: Wispr Flow for Android
records.tagline: AI dictation that turns messy speech into polished text.
records.description: Now on Android: smart voice-to-text that turns rambling speech into clean, ready-to-send text. Wispr Flow works seamlessly in any app, continues across app switches, and cleans up filler words, course corrections, punctuation, and formatting automatically. Free and unlimited for a limited time only!

records.name: TypeBoost
records.tagline: Your personal AI writing toolkit. Inside any app.
records.description: Turn your prompts into a personal AI writing toolkit. Use it inside any app on macOS. No copy-paste. No switching tools. Apply custom AI actions directly to selected text, see and control every change, and write faster while still sounding like you. Fully customizable prompts, model choice, voice input, and learning over time. Better writing. Faster. Still yours.

records.name: Siteline
records.tagline: Growth analytics for the agentic web
records.description: Track how AI agents and bots interact with your website. Analyze traffic trends by platform, page, and topic. See how this traffic turns into human visits. Get your first insights in minutes - and go deeper once you have your aha moment about how it impacts your product growth.

records.name: SnapTalk
records.tagline: Social ,Group chat
records.description: Short living chat rooms for everyone. People always want to group themselves That group can't be permanent whatsapp or telegram group or Sub Reddit chat rooms for ephemeral content(Carpooling to amazon office by 5pm, US Visa interview - Feb 23,Delhi, Traveling to China from Seattle) Your post will be auto deleted after 24 hours

records.name: ReScanFlow
records.tagline: Autonomous AI Agent Scanner for Web Security & UI Issues
records.description: Automated web security scanning and UI testing. Continuously scan your websites for vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and security issues before attackers find them.

records.name: MarkView: Offline Doc Viewer
records.tagline: View & edit Markdown, JSON, and Text files 100% locally
records.description: Most document viewers rely on cloud uploads, compromising your privacy and draining data. MarkView is a 100% offline, privacy-first document viewer. Read and edit Markdown, JSON, and plain text instantly. Features include a powerful Converter Suite (PDF to Markdown / Markdown to PDF), auto-detecting syntax highlighting, and lightning-fast search for massive files. Your data never leaves your device. Built for speed, offline access, and complete privacy.

records.name: SecureSpells
records.tagline: Find GDPR risks on your live site before regulators do
records.description: Most privacy scanners only list cookies. SecureSpells analyzes real runtime behavior to detect the GDPR risks they miss — like pre-consent scripts, hidden trackers, and risky third-party flows. Each issue includes: • A clear risk score • Technical fix instructions • Direct GDPR references Built for developers and agencies who need real compliance answers — not cookie lists. Run a free scan in seconds. No signup required.

records.name: AgentBoard
records.tagline: AgentBoard — Kanban for AI agents
records.description: AgentBoard is an acceptance-driven development board where AI agents work through a structured pipeline — and humans stay in control. How it works 1. Create a task — describe what you need built 2. AI agent auto-plans — generates an implementation plan and submits for review 3. You approve or reject — with comments that guide the agent 4. Agent implements — writes decision logs explaining key choices 5. You accept or send back — final quality gate before marking done

records.name: Market Eagle
records.tagline: AI agents analyze your competitors so you don't have to
records.description: Market Eagle lets AI agents do your competitive research while you focus on strategy. Connect the agent to Claude or ChatGPT, name your competitors, and get a structured analysis in minutes instead of days. The agent researches pricing, positioning, target audience, strengths, weaknesses, and more across hundreds of sources. All findings live in a dashboard with verified sources, not in a spreadsheet nobody updates. Your team can trigger updates at any time. Free plan included.

records.name: Reel-E Engine
records.tagline: The AI inference stack behind 47,000 real estate videos
records.description: Reel-E Engine is the custom inference pipeline behind Reel-E.ai. It runs real estate specific AI models that understand how properties look on camera. The full pipeline takes listing photos and outputs cinematic tour videos, handling motion, music sync, transitions, and multi-format rendering end to end. Every model is optimized for speed and cost so agents get videos in two minutes. Built for real estate from day one, not a generic video API with a template on top. 47,000+ videos and counting.

records.name: SkillMint
records.tagline: Master soft skills in just 5 min a day
records.description: You’ve read the books and watched the TED talks. But when it’s time to give tough feedback or lead a hard conversation — you freeze. Soft skills are learned by doing, not reading. SkillMint gives you daily 5-min drills — real workplace scenarios where you make decisions, get AI feedback, and reflect on how to apply it at work. Your daily career flight simulator.

records.name: Aani Speech Practice & Play Back App
records.tagline: Personalized speech practice for aphasia recovery
records.description: Personalized speech practice for aphasia recovery. Build the words that 1.7M Americans have aphasia from stroke—they can think clearly but can't find the words. Generic speech apps force them through irrelevant drills. AANI flips this: you build word lists that matter to YOUR life—gardening terms, family names, your dog's commands. Practice with voice playback, compare recordings, then copy-paste words straight into texts. Image-to-words lets you capture vocabulary from photos. 100% personalized

records.name: Mentist
records.tagline: Deploy OpenClaw in VPS within few seconds in just few clicks
records.description: Mentist lets you deploy OpenClaw — the open-source AI agent — on your own private, encrypted VPS in under a minute. No Docker, no servers, no DevOps. Works with Claude, GPT-4o, Gemini, Grok & more. Connect to Telegram, Discord, WhatsApp, and Slack instantly.

records.name: Viveka — Ancient Wisdom
records.tagline: Where ancient wisdom meets your modern questions.
records.description: Every Gita app gives you verses. Viveka gives you understanding. It doesn't match keywords to quotes — it reads what you're actually carrying and finds the exact moment in 5000 years of wisdom where someone faced the same thing. It speaks your language, literally — English, Hindi, Gujarati. It knows when your question needs the Gita, and when it needs to go deeper into the Upanishads or Mahabharata. No religion. No preaching. Just wisdom, made human.

records.name: Cignotee
records.tagline: Offline-first app to build & manage product lists in seconds
records.description: Cignotee is an offline-first digital list app for managing products, prices, and quantities quickly, built with a clean architecture and AI-assisted development.

records.name: TunnelPilot
records.tagline: Turn Localhost Into a Public Link in Seconds
records.description: Create secure public URLs for your local apps in seconds. Perfect for sharing projects, testing webhooks, and remote access. Just select a port, start a tunnel, and share the generated link.

records.name: MutyWork
records.tagline: Not just Cowork for task automation. Your local AI workspace
records.description: MutyWork brings together AI-powered desktop task execution, Obsidian-style note-taking, and native Office editing into a single, local workspace. Unlike task-focused AI tools, it's designed to unify your entire knowledge workflow. You can generate documents, seamlessly edit Word/Excel/PPT files — all without ever leaving the app. Everything runs locally, so your data never leaves your device. It's more than an AI that executes tasks; it's an AI that becomes your workspace.

records.name: Nexum Five
records.tagline: Everyone gives you answers. We give you an unfair advantage.
records.description: Every play from every category-defining mind, working on your actual problem the second you need it. The FBI on your negotiation. The Persuasion expertise to your outreach. Human behaviour specialist on your audience. Not theory. Execution. One click, no translation step. You're never alone with the moment again.

records.name: Speedo
records.tagline: Your perfect trip companion. Speed and trip recorder
records.description: Speedo turns your iPhone into a smart GPS speedometer and trip recorder for car and bike rides. Track real-time speed, enable HUD mode to project it onto your windscreen, record every drive with detailed stats, and revisit routes on an interactive map. Use Drag Race mode to measure acceleration runs (0–60, 0–100) and unlock badges as you improve. Built to be simple, accurate, and fun for everyday driving or performance tracking.

records.name: BUDGT
records.tagline: Know What You Can Spend Today
records.description: BUDGT answers one question: "How much can I spend today?" After 13 years on the App Store, we rebuilt it from scratch — new design, analytics, category targets — while keeping what works: 100% offline, no bank connection, no cloud. What's new: • Complete redesign • Analytics: spending pace, patterns, month comparison • Category targets and drill-down What stays the same: • 100% offline — data never leaves your device • No account, no signup • One daily number iOS only - Android in 2 weeks🚀

records.name: Clibben | Save & Organize Your Bookmarks
records.tagline: Organize and find links instantly.
records.description: A simple tool designed to help you save, organize, and find your bookmark links instantly. Clibben keeps your digital life tidy and your most important resources just one click away.

records.name: Replit Animated Videos
records.tagline: AI-Powered Motion Graphics
records.description: Generate professional animated videos from everyday language prompts. No expensive agencies or editing skills needed. Built on React with smooth transitions, text overlays, and AI imagery. Export as MP4 or share instantly.

records.name: OpenHunt
records.tagline: AI-native launch layer for the post-algorithm internet
records.description: SaaS launch platforms are dead. Attention hacks and upvote circles don’t scale in the AI era. OpenHunt is the AI-native discovery layer for builders. Humans submit products. Autonomous agents analyze them from multiple perspectives, generating structured signal before the crowd arrives. Then humans validate what truly deserves attention. No gatekeepers. No algorithm gaming. Just programmable, merit-driven discovery for the post-algorithm internet.

records.name: YAP
records.tagline: YAP teaches you to speak a language, not tap it.
records.description: Language apps have a dirty secret: they teach you to tap, not talk. After 300+ days on Duolingo, most users still can't hold a conversation. YAP is built around speaking from day one. You talk, our AI listens, and gives real-time feedback on your pronunciation. Every lesson you complete is verified onchain as a Proof of Language Learning credential. Just actual speaking practice. Give us an early test as we continue to improve our product! Love, YAP

records.name: SkillForge
records.tagline: Turn Screen Recordings into Agent-Ready Skills
records.description: First app to turn your Cross-App daily workflow into an Agent skill (like for OpenClaw). Stop writing automation scripts by hand. SkillForge transforms a simple screen recording into a structured, replayable skill your AI agent can execute autonomously. How it works: 1. Record — do the task naturally 2. Extract — AI analyzes every frame and action 3. Review — edit the step-by-step workflow 4. Deploy — export as SKILL.md for any agent Works with any App. Free recording + 100 signup credits.

records.name: Stoic Focus
records.tagline: Minimalist new tab for daily intention & year progress.
records.description: Replace your cluttered new tab with a calming, deep-space interface. Stoic Focus visualizes your year's progress, lets you set one meaningful daily focus, and delivers daily Stoic wisdom. 100% free, ad-free, and privacy-first.

records.name: Donotify
records.tagline: Never miss a Google Calendar event, get a real phone call
records.description: DoNotify turns Google Calendar events into real voice calls. When an event is due, it rings your phone and speaks the details aloud, cutting through silent mode and Do Not Disturb. No notification to swipe away. Just a call you can't miss. New: email backup reminders, Google Sign-In, API integrations, and international phone support. 3 free calls to try, no card needed.

records.name: ReceiptAPI
records.tagline: Extract exactly the JSON fields you need from any receipt
records.description: Most receipt OCR APIs return fixed fields — you get what they give you. ReceiptAPI lets you define your own output schema. Need just vendor + total? Pass that. Need line items with SKUs and unit costs? Define exactly that. ✦ Send a receipt image (URL, upload, or base64), pass a schema, get back clean JSON ✦ 100 free receipts/month — at $9/mo for 1,000 receipts, a fraction of what competitors charge ✦ Async endpoint for batch processing ✦ Simple REST API with API key auth

records.name: Toolura Calc
records.tagline: 100+ Free Calculators for Finance,Students and Health etc.
records.description: Access 150+ professional, high-precision tools for finance, health, academic, and math calculations. Toolura Calc – where calculations meet simplicity.

records.name: Goodnewsnetwork
records.tagline: Blogging
records.description: Blogger site

records.name: PipedriveSheets
records.tagline: Two-way sync between Pipedrive CRM and Google Sheets
records.description: PipedriveSheets is the only Google Sheets add-on with true two-way sync for Pipedrive CRM. Import deals, contacts, organizations, activities, leads, and products — then edit directly in your spreadsheet and push changes back to Pipedrive with one click. Filter-based imports, custom field support, scheduled auto-sync, and team collaboration built in. Free plan available. Install in 2 minutes, no coding needed.

records.name: MadCrawl
records.tagline: $59 once. Full SEO site auditor. Yours forever.
records.description: MadCrawl is a desktop SEO audit tool you buy once and own forever. Crawl any website, run 80+ checks across technical SEO, on-page, performance, accessibility, and AI Overview readiness. Generate white-label reports with your logo. Clients see your name, not ours. Audit unlimited sites for one price. Runs on your machine, client data stays private. $59 launch price for the first 50 buyers. Built for freelancers, consultants, and small agencies tired of paying monthly for tools they should own.

records.name: Magic Estimations
records.tagline: Want to beat inconsistent estimations in scrum teams?
records.description: Use visual Reference Stories when voting -> synchronously drag & drop tickets on http://magic-estimations.com on the correct column to submit votes, then choose the most voted column and move on with your life!

records.name: Heartfelt.ai
records.tagline: Heartfelt wishes powered by AI
records.description: Turn your feelings into beautiful, personalized greeting cards in seconds. No design skills needed—just your love and our AI.

records.name: fiftie
records.tagline: 12s to create a compliant invoice. For freelancers in France
records.description: Fiftie is an invoicing app for freelancers and micro-entrepreneurs in France. Create compliant invoices in 12 seconds — no credit card to start. What makes us different: the best invoicing UX in France, and AgendaSync — sync your calendar and turn sessions into invoices in one click. Free: 3 invoices, 3 quotes, 5 saved clients. Premium: €5.90/month for unlimited invoices, email delivery, AgendaSync, custom logo. Ready for 2026 e-invoicing. Cancel anytime.

records.name: WTF Happened in 2012?
records.tagline: Something snapped in 2012. WTF Happened?
records.description: Long-term data showing societal, economic, and behavioral change around 2012.

records.name: Website Defender
records.tagline: A lightweight WAF with a hacker style
records.description: A lightweight WAF (Web Application Firewall) for protecting web applications

records.name: DomainRisk.io
records.tagline: The all-inone auditor for domain security and health monitor
records.description: Monitor WHOIS, DNS, SSL and email security across your domain portfolio with an explainable risk score, subdomain takeover detection, change alerts and audit-ready PDF reports. Free trial, no credit card.

records.name: NerdSip
records.tagline: Use your idle time to become smarter
records.description: Micro-learning app for busy people that delivers bite-sized lessons tailored to your interests. Sip knowledge, one drop at a time. Learn ANY topic imagineable. // Get Promoted: Ace exams and interviews. Master the skills that get you hired. // Sound Brilliant: Own the room. Never run out of interesting things to say. // Reclaim Your Brain: Swap empty feeds for real growth. Feel sharp, not drained. // The 10-Minute Edge: Turn dead travel time into your daily unfair advantage.

records.name: Edlide
records.tagline: AI code editor and CLI that puts open models first
records.description: Open source AI models have caught up to closed alternatives and cost 10x less. Break free from closed AI ecosystems.

records.name: iPhone Concierge
records.tagline: iPhone settings guidance for unpaid family IT
records.description: iPhone Concierge makes iPhone settings less overwhelming. Instead of saying “Go to Settings…”, it opens the exact screen and guides you step-by-step in plain language. Built for anyone who ends up as unpaid family tech support. No app install required — just a lightweight web experience using iOS deep links and Shortcut relays to bridge browser → system settings.

records.name: Quick Translate for macOS
records.tagline: Instant HUD translation with CMD+C+C, Apple on-devie
records.description: Quick Translate is a macOS menu bar app for instanttext translation. Press CMD+C twice and a HUD appear near your cursor with the result — no app switching clipboard untouched. Faster than DeepL's CMD+C+C fow, and fully on-device via Apple Translation APIs. • CMD+C+C global shortcut • HUD overlay, clipboard itact • Menu bar only, no Dock icon • Multiple targetlanguages • Launch at Login • Open source (MIT), macS 26+

records.name: ZipPixel
records.tagline: Compress images instantly without losing quality
records.description: ZipPixel is a modern image compression tool built for developers, designers, and creators who need fast and efficient image optimization. It uses a high-performance compression engine to significantly reduce file sizes while preserving visual quality. The platform supports popular formats including JPG, PNG, WebP, and AVIF.

records.name: Collage Maker : Vizbull
records.tagline: Turn your photos into beautiful memories
records.description: Vizbull is an advanced collage maker that transforms any shape, silhouette, number, or SVG into a customizable photo collage. Create color-tinted collages, adjust micro-photo tiles, and export print-ready artwork in high resolution. ✨ Create shape collages (hearts, numbers, animals, sports shapes & more) 📐 Use ready-made photo grid layouts Whether you're designing: Birthday collages Wedding gifts Sports team memories Social media graphics Personalized wall art Vizbull makes it effortless.

records.name: CandidatePilot
records.tagline: The AI recruiter that screens 200 CVs while you grab coffee
records.description: Tired of reading 200 resumes one by one? CandidatePilot uses AI to generate custom evaluation criteria from your job posting, score every CV, and deliver a ranked shortlist with a Top 3 recommendation. Free to start, no integrations needed. Made for startups and hiring managers.
